import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression

# Extract the relevant columns for analysis
# For the year 2015 as a representative year
education_expenditure = adjusted_savings_df['2015 [YR2015]'].values
gni_per_capita = gni_per_capita_df['2015 [YR2015]'].values
economic_output = exports_df['2015 [YR2015]'].values

# Correlation analysis
correlation_education_gni = np.corrcoef(education_expenditure, gni_per_capita)[0, 1]
correlation_education_output = np.corrcoef(education_expenditure, economic_output)[0, 1]
correlation_gni_output = np.corrcoef(gni_per_capita, economic_output)[0, 1]

# Regression analysis
# Education expenditure vs. GNI per capita
X_education_gni = education_expenditure.reshape(-1, 1)
y_gni = gni_per_capita
model_education_gni = LinearRegression()
model_education_gni.fit(X_education_gni, y_gni)
coefficient_education_gni = model_education_gni.coef_[0]

# Education expenditure vs. economic output
X_education_output = education_expenditure.reshape(-1, 1)
y_output = economic_output
model_education_output = LinearRegression()
model_education_output.fit(X_education_output, y_output)
coefficient_education_output = model_education_output.coef_[0]

# GNI per capita vs. economic output
X_gni_output = gni_per_capita.reshape(-1, 1)
y_output = economic_output
model_gni_output = LinearRegression()
model_gni_output.fit(X_gni_output, y_output)
coefficient_gni_output = model_gni_output.coef_[0]

correlation_education_gni, correlation_education_output, correlation_gni_output, coefficient_education_gni, coefficient_education_output, coefficient_gni_output
